comparison_rule: Each portfolio row includes absolute pre-tax capital/path results and matched lifts to B167/B170 where exact support and funding permit, strongest standalone on its exact support, and equal-weight same sleeves.
component_rule: BJ145_ALLOCATION_MECHANISMS is composable only: pair each frozen allocation tuple with an eligible complete selector identity; never invent a selector or overwrite its inherited tuple.

excluded_source_records.reason: terminal strict promotion count is zero; coverage-limited diagnostic is not an eligible complete capital sleeve
PI excludes negative non-promoted FULL_DYNAMIC_CHAIN; package supplies interface/accounting lessons only

materialization_rule: Gate B enumerates every immutable source-plan/grid identity from each eligible source, retaining exact selector, support, M, seed, mechanism, cap, weight source and ticket multiplicity. It writes every nonempty same-support portfolio combination permitted by those identities.
screening_rule: The full materialized frontier is exploratory except the fixed H1. Raw rank, raw Pareto membership or a best descriptive cell cannot be reported as Edge; all positive claims require the frozen family-wise sequential inference and later independent validation.
